annotations.title: Save the person's request and open their free Geoniks account

description: Call this early in the conversation, once the person has said what they want and agreed to leave their contact details: it saves their request for the Geoniks team, opens a free Geoniks account for their email (they get a sign-in link by email, so designs and offers are kept in one place) and returns the next step for the chosen path — they have a drawing (PDF, DWG, DXF, IFC, SketchUp, photo), want a house designed from scratch, or want prices from manufacturers. Requires their own email, their country and consent_to_contact = true. Set consent_to_share = true only if they also agreed that their request and contact details go to wooden house manufacturers.

area_m2.description: Floor area in m², if known.

consent_to_contact.description: true only if the person agreed that Geoniks saves their details, opens their free account and contacts them.

consent_to_share.description: true only if they also agreed that manufacturers in their country receive the request and contact details.

country.description: Country where they want to build.

design_id.description: Id of a Geoniks design made in this conversation, if any.

drawing_format.description: If they have a drawing: what kind (PDF, photo, DWG, DXF, IFC, SketchUp, Revit …).

email.description: The person's email address, as they gave it.

notes.description: Anything else: budget, timing, plot, wishes.

user_request.description: What the person asked for, in one short sentence in their own words (no contact details).

name: save_contact_and_request
title: Save the person's request and open their free Geoniks account
